label: copy phase, middle-to-late recall in long sequences (strongest on input r)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L); never during original tokens or at <DEL>. Rate rises steeply with sequence length (L=9: 64% of mass, L=8: 25%, L<=5 ~0). Within the copy it is concentrated from recall_idx 3 onward (peak recall_idx 3-4, a second bump at the last outputs of L=9). Magnitude is strongly modulated by the fed-back input token: r is by far the strongest (5.4x lift, 32% of mass, all top examples are r input at recall_idx 3), then f, t, 3, y, x. Fires weakly or not at all on many other letters, so precision of the positional predicate is low (~0.29); adding a token whitelist raises precision to ~0.45 but loses recall. Simple position predicate captures ~83% of mass on dev.
